subject: How to detect when running on shinyapps.io?

messages.author: 1d22b88696fb889c
messages.subject: How to detect when running on shinyapps.io?
parts:
Is there a way to detect if an application is running on shinyapps.io (vs. running locally)?

For example, in the Docker world, you can do this:

if (file.exists("/.dockerinit")) {
  # Running in a Docker container

}

Any equivalent for shinyapps.io?

Thanks,
Eric

messages.author: 0cc92ffed03a9088
messages.subject: Re: How to detect when running on shinyapps.io?
parts:
Here is something simple:
##
# Am I on shinyapps.io or running Local
#
isLocal <<- Sys.getenv('SHINY_PORT') == ""
if(isLocal) {
  cat(file=stderr(),"App running on Local ...\n")
} else {
  cat(file=stderr(),"App running on Shinyapps.io...\n")
}
